recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if the work group wants a separate narrative example for absent expression results or a broader review of how the DefinedParameters profile is surfaced.
issue_request: FHIR-32965 asked for null or absent expression evaluation results to be represented in Parameters by using dataAbsentReason in the DefinedParameters profile instead of omitting parameters or using string placeholders such as "null".
initial_application: FHIR-32963 first created the DefinedParameters profile and Parameters CQF implementation guide reference in commit 272e3fb71ecb0d87630a48101b00015f0f18b038. FHIR-32965 was then applied in commit 12ad078437bbe021259be0e479dfa2ceeb986f92, which added Parameters.parameter.value[x] and a Parameters.parameter.value[x].extension:dataAbsentReason slice pointing to http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/data-absent-reason.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists Parameters as an active concrete resource, and source/parameters/implementationguide-Parameters-cqf.xml references StructureDefinition/definedparameters. The current profile still contains the dataAbsentReason slice with max 1 and mustSupport true. Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no later reversal or conflicting guidance.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the authoritative source already satisfies the issue. No narrative was added because duplicating the profile rule on the Clinical Reasoning Using Expressions page would not change implementer obligations.
